examples.explanation: The longest palindromic prefix has length 7; mirroring the leftover "a" gives "aaacecaaa".
Only "a" is a palindromic prefix, so "dcb" is prepended.
Already a palindrome, so nothing is added.

hints: Only the longest prefix of s that is already a palindrome can stay; everything after it must be mirrored to the front.
Find that prefix length with KMP on s + '#' + reverse(s): the final prefix-function value is the answer length.
The result is reverse(suffix) + s, where suffix is the part after the palindromic prefix.
title: 332. Shortest Palindrome
